Subject: Payment received but not allocated - need VAT/EORI evidence

Hi Tessa,

We received a single settlement from Acme Media on 2025-06-09 (bank ref ACME-3321) that covers multiple invoice lines. Our auto-match failed because the remittance advice did not include EORI or a VAT breakout for the EU/UK split. The funds posted to your virtual account 400-ACME-02.

- Confirm which invoice numbers the payment should be applied to (Acmereferences are helpful)
- Provide VAT rates per invoice and any EORI numbers needed for posting
- Optionally re-upload an updated remittance PDF to merchant portal ticket TKT-9247 so our team can finish posting

Attached: bank confirmation (acme_remittance_20250610.pdf).

Cheers,

Subject: Fwd: Payment received but not allocated - need VAT/EORI evidence

Laura / Vanessa,

Looping you in on an Acme reconciliation gap. They sent a single gross payment that we believe covers two invoices: INV-2025-1102 (EUR 42,000) and INV-2025-1103 (EUR 8,600). Acmedid not include per-invoice VAT split or EORI, so their gateway couldn't auto-apply.

Can finance confirm by EOD: 
- Which invoice IDs to apply the cash to (confirm the two above),
- VAT treatment per invoice (standard VAT vs reverse-charge),
- Any EORI string we should include when we post back to the portal (Acme has UK and EU entities).

Also please draft a one-line authorisation statement we can paste to the merchant portal ticket confirming Redwood approves the allocation.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Revenue Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa / Vanessa,

We reviewed the batch and matched the amounts to INV-2025-1102 and INV-2025-1103. Finance confirms application to those invoices.

VAT position:
- INV-2025-1102: Standard VAT at 20% (customer was invoiced gross).
- INV-2025-1103: Reverse-charge applies; Acme provided a DE EORI (DE123456789) and is VAT-registered in DE.

Suggested short portal note you can paste: "Redwood authorises application of payment ACME-3321 to INV-2025-1102 and INV-2025-1103; VAT allocation: 20% (INV-2025-1102) and reverse-charge (INV-2025-1103, EORI DE123456789)."

I attached a bank trace with our ledger refs (GL:4100, batch P-20250609): bank_trace_0625.txt. I also added a HubSpot comment on deal ACM-2024-095.
